#!/usr/bin/env python3
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

def fix_context_assembly_test\(content\):
    """Fix ContextAssemblyServiceImplTest specific issues"""
    # Fix story.getId\(\).getValue\(\).equals\(\) calls
    content = re.sub\(
        r'story\\.getId\\\(\\\)\\.getValue\\\(\\\)\\.equals\\\("PROJECT-PLANNING"\\\)',
        'story.getId\(\).getValue\(\).equals\("PROJECT-PLANNING"\)',
        content
    \)
    
    # Fix ReferenceFile API - .getName\(\) doesn't exist, use .getPath\(\)
    content = re.sub\(
        r'\\.getName\\\(\\\)\\.endsWith\\\("\\.md"\\\)',
        '.getPath\(\).getFileName\(\).toString\(\).endsWith\(".md"\)',
        content
    \)
    
    return content

def fix_file\(filepath\):
    """Comprehensively fix a test file"""
    with open\(filepath, 'r'\) as f:
        content = f.read\(\)
    
    original_content = content
    
    # Fix Story constructors - ensure all have 5 params with WorkflowState
    # Pattern: Story\(id, title, desc, prioritization\) -> Story\(id, title, desc, WorkflowState.TODO, prioritization\)
    # This handles any remaining 4-param constructors
    content = re.sub\(
        r'new Story\\\(\\s*\([^,]+\),\\s*"\([^"]*\)",\\s*"\([^"]*\)",\\s*PrioritizationState\\.\(\\w+\)\\s*\\\)',
        r'new Story\(\\1, "\\2", "\\3", WorkflowState.TODO, PrioritizationState.\\4\)',
        content
    \)
    
    # Apply context assembly specific fixes
    if 'ContextAssemblyServiceImplTest' in filepath:
        content = fix_context_assembly_test\(content\)
    
    # Only write if changed
    if content != original_content:
        with open\(filepath, 'w'\) as f:
            f.write\(content\)
        print\(f"✓ Fixed {filepath}"\)
        return True
    else:
        print\(f"  No changes needed for {filepath}"\)
        return False

def main\(\):
    if len\(sys.argv\) < 2:
        print\("Usage: fix_tests.py <file1> <file2> ..."\)
        sys.exit\(1\)
    
    fixed_count = 0
    for filepath in sys.argv[1:]:
        if fix_file\(filepath\):
            fixed_count += 1
    
    print\(f"\\nFixed {fixed_count} files"\)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main\(\)
EOFPYTHON)
